name: thalpos
description: Keeps the prompt cache of the main conversation warm for a bounded period with cheap forked pings.

max_hours.title: Maximum hours
max_hours.description: The longest period /keep-warm start accepts, in hours.

autostart.title: Allow automatic start
autostart.description: Let the THALPOS_AUTOSTART variable start a keep-warm period by itself. Off: the variable is ignored.
